notes:
Summary: Stalled account — POC completed but closed-lost on 2026-01 cycle. Primary reason: integration friction + internal budget freeze. Sales cadence slowed after security flagged gaps. AE + SE did 3 demos; SRE/security engaged but requested design-level artifacts and traceability before procurement.

Key quotes: "We liked the latency numbers, but we can't ship without end-to-end tracing and a formal SAML pattern for our Okta instantiation." — VP Eng (12/02).

Integration pain points observed: SDKs: only Python/Node examples shipped; engineering uses JVM + .NET microservices and said porting effort ~4-6 wks. Auth: SAML flows with our IdP (Okta) fail edge-case for metadata rotation; no clear vendor guide. Observability: no built-in OpenTelemetry tracing hooks exposed in the hosted runtime; team wanted token-level cost traces and span correlation across batching boundaries. Runtime: missing a prebuilt connector for their in-house metrics backend (Prometheus -> Grafana).

Commercial: initially attractive committed pricing for Dedicated, but procurement put a hold (budget freeze) Jan 2026. Competitor notes: Anthropic won the POC by shipping a quick JVM SDK and a short security runbook; also offered a temporary seat on their private preview for integration assistance.

Current sentiment: lukewarm. Technical champions are now busy; primary champion (Sr. ML Engineer) moved to a different initiative. Security interested but requests: detailed SAML flow doc, SOC2 artefact, HSM/KMS key rotation plan, and an observability integration plan (OpenTelemetry + sample spans).

Sales shorthand / next actions: short-term — deliver security design doc and a Java SDK 0.1 alpha + sample OTel hooks; ask AE to re-engage champion and schedule 30m with SecOps. If budget remains frozen, ask for commitment to internal pilot in Q3. Marking as "needs internal champion" for replay.

Stated blockers in conversation: "No champion, can't risk more eng cycles, competitor already provided certs and runbook."
